purpose: Positive control: repeated valid imports add no binding or behavior and should be reported as an import streak.

informed_by.title: No More Import Errors: Constrained Decoding for Guaranteed Valid Imports in LLM-Generated Tests

density_expectation.rule: Report the repeated import run even though every import statement is valid and the final binding is used.

functional_oracle.contract: Return the final suffix from a path.

report_expectation.required_scope_statement: Slop density only — not functional correctness, security, or authorship
